title: Privacy Policy
author: djordjem
excerpt: A plain-language privacy note for the static Mindfulness Journey website.
contentHtml:
About this website

Mindfulness Journey is a static website. It has no user accounts, comments, contact forms, newsletter signup, advertising, or on-site payment features. The site itself does not use analytics or set marketing cookies.

Email

If you choose to contact me by email, the message is handled by your email provider and the recipient email provider. Only include information you are comfortable sending by email.

External websites

This site links to services such as Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, and Amazon. Those websites have their own privacy policies and may collect information when you visit them.

Hosting

The hosting provider may process basic technical request information, such as IP address, browser details, and request time, for security and reliable delivery of the website.

Contact

For privacy questions, email info@georgemposi.com.
